lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, but underestimated gains on several winning home wait_info tests.
Adding new screens at adoption (2 tests) or finish (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and triggered early stops.
Redesigning the adoption stage (2 wins) and choose_path stage (2 wins) proved helpful, and home wait_info updates generated four wins despite many showing no clear effect.
Finish copy changes (4 tests), finish layout changes (2 tests), sign-in hints (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories with only one test or conflicting non-significant results.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Mascot Journey Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story screen into a story_scroll layout featuring animated mascot visuals and embedded companion path selection choices.
candidates.why: choose_path has 79.5% conversion with a high mean completion time (514s); choose_path stage redesigns have previously driven strong performance gains.

guard.reason: Embedding path choices into the story screen removes or skips the required choose_path onboarding step.

candidates.title: Carousel Friend Chooser Stage
candidates.change: Rebuild the pick_friend screen into a carousel stage layout for browsing available desktop companions with high-visibility preview cards.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is 77.7% and redesigning adoption screens produced wins in earlier experiments.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend into a carousel layout preserves companion selection and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns have proven highly effective with +4.4% average lift.

candidates.title: Sign-In Pet Recovery Protection Banner
candidates.change: Update the sign-in screen headline and hint copy to emphasize account creation prevents pet data resets upon re-login.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, highlighting account safety concerns.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet & Progress
sign_in.hint: Signing in anchors your companion data so your pet never resets across logins.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to clarify pet progress saving is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails and funnel drop; cost is minimal.

candidates.title: Deferred Sign-In After Adoption Flow
candidates.change: Reorder onboarding so the sign_in step occurs after adoption_certificate instead of before pet selection.
candidates.why: Sign-in step drops 24.9% of users early; moving account setup after pet adoption increases user commitment.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Adopted Pet to Account

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in after adoption has proven success (+2.4% avg).

candidates.title: Interactive Pre-Launch Desktop Quick Tour

candidates.why: Support emails highlight post-onboarding confusion around controlling and hiding pets; setting expectations early improves long-term engagement.

guard.reason: Adding video preview and choice cards to choose_path maintains its function of offering pet creation paths.

candidates.score_note: New flows consistently hurt conversion (-2.4% avg) and add dev effort.

components.text: Assembling desktop pet visuals and animations...

candidates.score_note: Adding real-time wait information addresses long wait times effectively.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Mascot Animation Showcase

components.text: Your companion is getting ready to land on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding mascot animations to the waiting screen maintains its core function of showing pet creation.

candidates.score_note: Visual feedback during home wait stage reliably improves engagement.

guard.reason: Replacing the official stamp with a generic text badge loses the required official stamp function on the certificate.
